notes: Term Protect Secure, Super CritiCare and DIRECT Term Lite entry ages exist only on the product pages, whose extracted text carries footnote tokens such as [@age-attained]; quotes keep them verbatim so they match the source. The footnote text is not on the page, so the age basis (attained / nearest birthday) is unknown and is not stated in v.

Super CritiCare: brochure headline says up to 600% of the sum assured but its footnote 5 says the cap for all cancers, heart attack and stroke is 300%; the product page and Term Protect Secure brochure (Sep 2026) say 600%, so 600% is used. Conditions count and waiting period after cover starts are not stated (only 11 special and 10 juvenile conditions, and a 12/24-month gap between successive claims), so both are left out.
Term Protect Advantage: policy term and entry age are not stated in the brochure or page (only a 35-year example), so left out. Its premium guarantee is not stated.
Term Protect Secure: terminal illness benefit and premium guarantee are not stated in its brochure or page, so left out.
DIRECT Term Lite: footnote 1 of the brochure limits renewal to the last applicable renewal age of 80. Premium guarantee not stated.

HSBC Life Enhanced Care II: the Shield brochure gives no rider-specific last entry age (the 75-year entry age shown belongs to the Shield table), so entry_age is left out. The 5% co-insurance and S$6,000 cap come from the rider benefit schedule, which does not split Plan A and Plan B for these rows. The page notes HSBC Life is being sold to Allianz (completion expected first half of 2027).
